{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
num_qa_orders = len(qa_orders)
print(f"Number of QA orders: {num_qa_orders}")

# Identify refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
num_refunded_orders = len(refunded_orders)
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {num_refunded_orders}")

# Filter out QA and refunded orders
clean_sales = sales[(sales['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99) & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
revenue_by_channel = clean_sales.groupby('channel')['revenue_numeric'].sum().round(2)
print("Revenue by channel (after cleaning):")
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with the most revenue
max_revenue_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
max_revenue_value = revenue_by_channel.max()
print(f"Channel with most revenue: {max_revenue_channel} with ${max_revenue_value}")"}
